name: Archer
fantasy: A red-hooded ranger with a carved recurve bow and his dire wolf at his side. Shoots on the move: fire arrows that burn through a line, frost volleys that chill, and a thunderstep that leaves a storm sigil behind him.

directions.name: Flame
directions.desc: Fire Arrow, burning wounds and the bow's weight; his wolf's fangs catch fire.

directions.name: Frost
directions.desc: Frost Volley, the chill that slows them and the hide that keeps him alive; his wolf howls the cold.

directions.name: Storm
directions.desc: Thunderstep, forked lightning and the bond with his wolf.

skills.name: Fire Arrow
skills.desc: A burning arrow that tears through every enemy in a line for 130% weapon damage and sets them alight: they burn for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Frost Volley
skills.desc: Loose a flight of frost arrows into the sky: they rain on the cursor for over a second, hitting everything within 4 metres again and again and chilling them (40% slower); the ground stays frozen for a few seconds, slowing everything that stands in it or crosses it.

skills.name: Thunderstep
skills.desc: Backflip away from the pointer, driving a thunderstone into a gold storm sigil where you stood. A moment later it detonates: everything on it is stunned and hurt, and lightning leaps on into the 3 nearest others beyond it.

skills.name: Spirit Beast
skills.desc: Your Spirit Beast hunts at your side from the start (and you run 10% faster with it). Command it: on an enemy it pounces and fights it, on open ground it holds there, on yourself it comes back. Each command rouses you both: +40% damage for 12 seconds.

rites.name: Kindling
rites.text: Fire Arrow deals {dmg:pierce}% more damage.

rites.name: Heavy Draw
rites.text: Your bow shots deal {dmg:attack}% more damage.

rites.name: Pyre
rites.text: Burning from Fire Arrow lasts and hurts {burn_dmg}% more.

rites.name: Quick Nock
rites.text: +{ias}% attack speed.

rites.name: Ember Fangs
rites.text: Your wolf's bites set foes alight: {wolf_burn}% of each bite burns them every second for 3 seconds.

rites.name: Deadeye
rites.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

rites.name: Split Arrow
rites.text: Every bow shot flies as three arrows (the outer two at half damage).

rites.name: Keen Eye
rites.text: +{dex} dexterity.

rites.name: Hailstorm
rites.text: Frost Volley covers {volley_size}% more ground.

rites.name: Rime
rites.text: Frost Volley's chill slows {chill_pct}% more.

rites.name: Hide Armour
rites.text: +{armor_pct}% defense.

rites.name: Winter Howl
rites.text: Your wolf's pounce chills everything within 3.5 metres of where it lands.

rites.name: Endless Rain
rites.text: Frost Volley recharges {cd:volley}% faster and costs {cost:volley}% less mana.

rites.name: Shatter
rites.text: Chilled enemies take 20% more damage from your arrows.

rites.name: Hunter's Vigor
rites.text: +{life_pct}% maximum life.

rites.name: Thunder Jaws
rites.text: Thunderstep's sigil deals {dmg:snare}% more damage and stuns {snare_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Forked Lightning
rites.text: Thunderstep's lightning leaps to {arc_count} more enemies.

rites.name: Spirit Bond
rites.text: Your wolf hits {dmg:beast}% harder.

rites.name: Aftershock
rites.text: Thunderstep's sigil strikes {snare_max} more time(s), a little weaker each time.

rites.name: Pack Hunter
rites.text: The hunt your commands rouse is {buff_pow}% stronger.

rites.name: Alpha
rites.text: A second wolf runs with you.
